in_sanskrit.name: Jivin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Consciousness, Alive
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jivin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jivin is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jiv' meaning 'consciousness' or 'alive'. It is a name that evokes a sense of vitality, energy, and consciousness. In Hindu mythology, Jivin is believed to represent the vital force that sustains all forms of life.
